name: ShiftKey Labs (Dalhousie)
reason: ShiftKey Labs is Dalhousie Faculty of Computer Science's lab in the Goldberg CS Building, Halifax, with a public The Events Calendar .ics. In 2026 it ran Global Game Jam Halifax, DHS Hack to the Future, Hack the Elements, the DalCTF capture-the-flag, SURGE Neuro-Hackathon, Mission Accepted Space Hackathon and AI2Market Demo Day, all in person. It also lists many student career workshops, which the relevance gate should drop.

name: Unreal LA
